Subject: DPIA and audit evidence needed for Northbridge integration

Hi Logan / Marissa,

We’re moving Northbridge’s procurement review to the legal and privacy teams — they’ve flagged a DPIA requirement tied to the new data flows. To complete our DPIA and procurement packet we need the following from Redwood:

- Current list of subprocessors and processing locations (Art. 28 list and whether transfers rely on SCCs or other safeguards)
- Excerpt of your Art. 30 processing register relevant to our integration (data categories, retention, categories of recipients)
- Clarification of audit rights: scope, data access (redacted v full), and whether remote evidence delivery is acceptable
- Any DPIA-support materials (dataflow diagrams, KMS/crypto notes, logging retention) you can provide in the next 10 business days

Procurement would prefer a short, limited process rather than an on-site inspection — they asked whether Redwood can provide a redacted evidence package plus a timeboxed remote walkthrough. Please confirm what you can share and the earliest available window for a 30–45 minute technical session.

Thanks,
Elena

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely support a DPIA-friendly delivery that meets procurement's preference for a remote, timeboxed process. Summary of what we propose: 

1) Evidence package (attached): redwood-dpa-draft-v3.docx + subprocessor-inventory-snapshot.csv + art30-ledger-excerpt.pdf. These contain our current Art. 28 statements, subprocessor locations, and a focused excerpt from our Art. 30 register covering the datasets you referenced.

2) Limited audit model:
   - Remote delivery of an evidence package (suitably redacted for PII) hosted in a shared Drive folder
   - Timeboxed 45-minute technical walkthrough with our privacy/infra leads (screen-share + Q&A)
   - If procurement requires additional verification, we will offer a recorded session of key log extracts rather than full access to live systems

3) Timeline: we can deliver the first evidence bundle by 2027-04-30 and offer walkthrough slots the week of 2027-05-03.

Karthik — I’ve looped you for legal/privacy redlines on the DPA and to confirm limits on audit scope and log disclosure. Marissa — can you copy the DocuSign link for the DPA when ready?

If that approach sounds acceptable to Northbridge, we’ll prepare the Drive link and DPA for signature.

Best,

Subject: Re: DPIA and audit evidence needed for Northbridge integration

Thanks — quick internal notes / suggested limits to include in the DPA appendix:

- Audit scope: limited to production environment artifacts that pertain to the integration subject (no broad tenant-level access).
- Notice period: 30 days written notice for any evidence request; audits to be scheduled within a 60-day window.
- Redaction: PII will be redacted unless a Data Processing Agreement addendum is signed and a lawful basis for access is shown.
- Evidence delivery options: 1) evidence package + live walkthrough, 2) recorded extracts of retention/logs, 3) auditor representation via vetted third party under NDA (we prefer 1 or 2).
- Timebox: typical walkthroughs limited to 2 business hours combined; deeper forensics require a scoped statement of work.

I’ve also added an Art. 30 excerpt (art30-ledger-excerpt.pdf) to the bundle — it contains processing categories and legal bases tied to the services you’ll consume. We should capture these limits in an appendix to the DPA so procurement can sign off without requiring a full on-site audit.

—Karthik
